pages.title: Protostellar Ember
pages.text: A shard of a star not yet lit, still glowing with the heat of its own collapse. A furnace of a fuel: it burns for a long time.
$(thing)Mined$(): from $(item)Protostar Fragment$(), in veins through the rock.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Accretion Physics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Accretion Disk Plasma, Quasar Jet Filament.
